Name: GCWA's Warbler Pack (For Ornithologist's Guild)
Author: GCWA
Description: Allows you to encounter different warblers including American Redstart, Black and White, Blackburnian, Chestnut-sided, Golden-cheeked,  Nashville, Northern Parula, Prothonotory, Wilson's, and Yellow with more to come!

Downloads.Description: Update normalizes audio clips of birdsong, adds Mangrove Yellow Warbler variant and Canada Warbler. Some bug fixes with bird attributes IDs.
